ICS 39.060
ICS 39.060

1 SCOPE
This specification covers the requirements for purity, finish, design, capacity, dimensions and weights of platinum crucibles (1 ml to 100 ml) and lid used in the laboratories.
2 REFERENCES
The standard given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
